description: This file implements checkpointing and wakeup functionalities for processes, including managing process metadata and placeholders for memory checkpointing operations.

classes.name: CheckpointMetaData
classes.description: Structure holding process ID for checkpointing purposes.

methods.name: HibernateProcess
methods.description: Creates a checkpoint of the specified process, storing its metadata.

methods.name: WakeupProcess
methods.description: Resumes a process from a checkpoint, freeing associated metadata.
